name: Example: parameters for component and threshold
description: Declares two parameters: component (one of a list) and threshold (a number). The first step counts the component's warnings and errors; the report step runs only when the count reaches the threshold. Scheduled runs use the defaults; Run now lets you pick other values.

steps.name: Count the component's problems
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd component=$run.param.component$ (log_level=ERROR OR log_level=WARN)
| stats count AS events

steps.name: List the problems
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd component=$run.param.component$ (log_level=ERROR OR log_level=WARN)
| stats count BY log_level, host
| sort - count

params.name: threshold
params.label: Threshold
params.description: Report when the component logged at least this many warnings and errors
